task_metadata.research_topic: conditioning injection mechanisms for class-conditional diffusion models on CIFAR-10
task_metadata.research_question: Which conditioning injection method achieves the best class-conditional FID on CIFAR-10 for a UNet-based DDPM trained and sampled with the provided scaffold?
notes: Baseline-to-paper mappings are approximate when the repository adapts a paper's conditioning mechanism to a UNet ResBlock scaffold rather than reproducing the original architecture verbatim.
All three test commands share the same dataset, training objective, sampling procedure, and evaluation metric; they differ only in model scale and runtime budget.

tests.label: train_small
tests.notes: Small-scale CIFAR-10 class-conditional DDPM training with DDIM sampling and FID computed via clean-fid.

tests.label: train_medium
tests.notes: Medium-scale variant of the same CIFAR-10 DDPM/DDIM/FID evaluation protocol.

tests.label: train_large
tests.notes: Large-scale variant of the same CIFAR-10 DDPM/DDIM/FID evaluation protocol.

baselines.name: concat-film
baselines.notes: The repo baseline uses FiLM-style feature-wise modulation inside a UNet with adaptive GroupNorm; this is closest to FiLM plus GroupNorm rather than a single canonical diffusion paper.

baselines.name: cross-attn
baselines.notes: The baseline adapts Stable-Diffusion-style cross-attention to class embeddings in a UNet ResBlock scaffold.

baselines.name: adanorm
baselines.notes: The implementation ports DiT's adaLN-style conditioning idea into a UNet post-ResBlock conditioner.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Foundational DDPM paper for the noise-prediction training objective and UNet-based diffusion setup used throughout the task scaffold.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.relevance: Matches the task's 50-step DDIM sampling procedure used during class-conditional inference.

papers.title: Improved Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Relevant adjacent work on DDPM training and faster sampling that informs diffusion baselines on small image benchmarks.

papers.title: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
papers.relevance: A central class-conditional diffusion reference showing strong FID performance and architecture ablations for conditional image synthesis.

papers.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
papers.relevance: Introduces the cross-attention conditioning pattern that the `cross-attn` baseline adapts from Stable Diffusion-style text conditioning to class embeddings.

papers.title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
papers.relevance: Primary reference for AdaLN-Zero conditioning, which the `adanorm` baseline ports into the task's UNet conditioner.

papers.title: FiLM: Visual Reasoning with a General Conditioning Layer
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.bibtex: @article{Perez_2018, title={FiLM: Visual Reasoning with a General Conditioning Layer}, volume={32}, ISSN={2159-5399}, url={http://dx.doi.org/10.1609/AAAI.V32I1.11671}, DOI={10.1609/aaai.v32i1.11671}, number={1}, journal={Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence}, publisher={Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AAAI)}, author={Perez, Ethan and Strub, Florian and De Vries, Harm and Dumoulin, Vincent and Courville, Aaron}, year={2018}, month=apr }
papers.relevance: Canonical FiLM reference for feature-wise affine conditioning, matching the conceptual core of the `concat-film` baseline.

papers.title: Group Normalization
papers.bibtex: @inbook{Wu_2018, title={Group Normalization}, ISBN={9783030012618}, ISSN={1611-3349}, url={http://dx.doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-01261-8_1}, DOI={10.1007/978-3-030-01261-8_1}, booktitle={Computer Vision – ECCV 2018}, publisher={Springer International Publishing}, author={Wu, Yuxin and He, Kaiming}, year={2018}, pages={3–19} }
papers.relevance: Supports the adaptive GroupNorm-style modulation used by the `concat-film` baseline inside the UNet ResBlocks.

papers.title: Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
papers.relevance: Relevant class-conditional diffusion reference on how conditioning information can be combined with the generative model without a separate classifier.

papers.title: GANs Trained by a Two Time-Scale Update Rule Converge to a Local Nash Equilibrium
papers.relevance: Introduces the Fréchet Inception Distance used as the task's primary evaluation metric.

papers.title: On Aliased Resizing and Surprising Subtleties in GAN Evaluation
papers.relevance: Directly underlies the clean-fid evaluation package referenced in the task description.

papers.title: Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images
papers.relevance: Repository-resolved citation for the CIFAR-10 dataset used by every evaluation script in this task.

papers.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
papers.relevance: Background architecture reference for the UNet family underlying the task's `UNet2DModel` scaffold.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.relevance: Background reference for the attention mechanism that underlies the `cross-attn` baseline's key/value conditioning module.

papers.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models
papers.relevance: Relevant recent diffusion-design paper with strong CIFAR-10 class-conditional FID results, useful context for the task's research question.
